quote: "No mind to think. No will to break. No voice to cry suffering."
question: A shell with nothing inside it. So what would it wear?
why_en: French Lover is Hallownest above: galbanum, juniper and incense over iris, oakmoss and cedar — cold stone, grey-green, rain that never stops in the City of Tears.
why_ar: وبيت أومان هو الفراغ في الداخل: ورق البنفسج والمستكة فوق البردي وزيت السيبريول وخشب الغاياك — جذورٌ وظلامٌ ولا ضوء.
